title_zh: 约好用点头提示旋律交接

scenario.label_zh: 约好用点头提示旋律交接
scenario.goal_zh: 指出双人排练中的进入时机问题，并约定先用点头提示慢速练习

context_zh: 两位业余乐手正在排练一首双人乐曲。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: When you take over the melody, I keep coming in a beat too early.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: I can hear that. We need a little more precision at the handover, not a faster tempo.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Could you nod just before my entry? I lose track when I look down at the music.

sentences.speaker: Kit
sentences.text: Yes. Watch me at the end of that phrase, and I’ll give you a small nod.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.text: Great. Let’s try that section slowly before we play the whole piece.
